description: The U.K. National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) has recommended Atezolizumab, within its marketing authorisation, as a treatment option for the adjuvant treatment of non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC) after complete resection and platinum-based chemotherapy in adults at high risk of recurrence whose tumours express PD-L1 on 50% or more of tumour cells and are not EGFR-mutant or ALK-positive. It is recommended only if the company provides atezolizumab according to the commercial arrangement.
